presentation.name: Harden a scheduled connector against silently dropped connections
presentation.summary: Makes a connector that runs on a schedule survive connections that die while it is idle, and fail fast instead of hanging when they do.
benefits: Gives every long-lived connection a recovery path, so one idle drop does not break the connector until a restart
Sets connect timeouts that cover the TLS or SSH handshake, not only the TCP connect
Traces cancellation from the entry point to every network call and names where it is dropped
Sizes operation deadlines to the payload instead of one fixed value
Adds protocol keepalive only where the protocol needs it, with Go and Python specifics
